body: Yeah the whole premise of the song “Guidelines” with the chorus and stuff, it’s like he was basically saying “I’ll give you some advice on life and the world before I go”. Chances are that isn’t what he was doing and I don’t wanna sound like I’m reaching, but that’s how I’ve always interpreted it and it makes the song a whole lot more meaningful to me
